requirement.requirement_text:
从表单提交获取交易名称、Google Drive 文件夹 ID 以及用于接收通知的邮箱地址。

为本次运行生成唯一运行标识，并列出该 Google Drive 数据室内的文件。随后逐个处理每个文件：从 Google Drive 下载文件并抽取文档文本；把抽取出的文本交给语言模型，用于判定文档类别并生成包含风险等级、标记项与简短摘要的发现结果；解析该结果后，把每个文档的发现追加到 Google Sheets 的尽职调查工作表。

全部文档处理完毕后，从 Google Sheets 取回本次运行的全部发现，交给语言模型起草一份尽职调查执行摘要；将摘要转换为 HTML，并通过邮件发送到提交时提供的通知邮箱。

工作流运行失败，以及语言模型分析与摘要环节返回的问题，都会向 Slack 发送告警。

source_spans.text: This workflow starts from an n8n form submission, reviews all documents in a Google Drive data room using OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini), logs per-document risk findings to Google Sheets, then compiles an executive summary and emails the report via Gmail, with Slack alerts for errors.
Receives a form submission with the deal name, Google Drive folder ID, and a notification email address.
Creates a unique run ID and lists files in Google Drive for the provided data room context.
Loops through each file, downloads it from Google Drive, and extracts the document text.
Sends the extracted text to OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) to classify the document and generate a JSON finding with risk level, flags, and a short summary.
Parses the AI output and appends each document’s finding to a Google Sheets “Due Diligence Findings” tab.
After all documents are processed, fetches all findings for the run from Google Sheets and sends them to OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) to draft an executive due diligence summary.
Converts the summary to HTML and sends it to the submitted notification email via Gmail.
Posts error alerts to Slack for workflow failures and for issues returned by the OpenAI analysis and summary steps.

inputs: 表单提交的 Google Drive 文件夹 ID
表单提交的通知邮箱地址
该 Google Drive 数据室内的文档文件
conditions: 为每次运行生成唯一运行标识
全部文档处理完毕后才生成执行摘要
allowed_actions: 列出并下载 Google Drive 中的文件
调用语言模型判定文档类别并生成风险等级、标记项与简短摘要
向 Google Sheets 追加每个文档的发现
取回本次运行全部发现并调用语言模型起草执行摘要
通过邮件把 HTML 摘要发送到通知邮箱
向 Slack 发送错误告警
visible_outcomes: Google Sheets 尽职调查工作表中每个文档一条发现记录，含风险等级、标记项与简短摘要
通知邮箱收到一份 HTML 格式的尽职调查执行摘要邮件
failure_behavior: 工作流运行失败时向 Slack 发送告警
语言模型分析与摘要环节返回问题时向 Slack 发送告警
